summary: The assigned configuration step has compatibility defects in saved-session normalization and preset precedence. The four supplied cases passed their focused checks, but neighboring cases demonstrate regressions.

outcomes.evidence: Review only; the checkout was not modified. The configuration contract does not yet preserve all legacy settings or preset precedence.

checks: Passed: timeout 60s env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<scratch> python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_slot_settings.py — 7 tests.
Passed: timeout 60s env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<scratch> python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_automation.py -k test_catalogs_include_distinct_processing_provider — 1 test.
Ran two bounded Python reproductions through settings.resolve and settings.from_manifest; they demonstrated the defects listed in blocking.

case_results.evidence: test_slot_settings.py passed the legacy provider ordering and explicit slot ordering case.
test_slot_settings.py passed saved reviewer-only and explicit processing override cases.
test_slot_settings.py passed the Review.configure check for unchanged and changed legacy settings.
The named automation test passed, checking discovery of both providers and real selection validation with mocked catalogs.

blocking: Canonical reviewer defaults survive loading a legacy saved configuration because settings.resolve overlays the manifest onto initial settings without removing provisional reviewer_slots. A reproduction with a saved Codex reviewer and a Claude slot in defaults resolves to Claude, silently changing the saved reviewer.

A legacy configuration containing reviewers=['codex'] but no processing_provider resolves to Claude processing: from_manifest inserts the legacy Claude default before validation. The previous validator selected the sole reviewer, so this changes the session's historical processing choice.

Preset precedence regresses when defaults specify a single reviewer. With defaults reviewers=['claude'] and economical=True, the resolved preset has both reviewers but Claude processing; the economical preset and prior behavior select Codex processing. Canonical reviewer_slots in defaults also remain active over the preset.
